To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gadag District Court to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Gadag District Court to fill vacancies for Peon positions across various categories as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Peon post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies available for the Peon post under the Gadag District Court recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Peon post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th Standard or equivalent examination and possess the knowledge to read and write Kannada fluently.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for General Merit candidates?
faq.answer: For General Merit candidates, the minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for Gadag District Court Peon Recruitment 2026 officially starts on 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and complete the fee payment is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General Merit candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General Merit candidates is Rs. 200/-, whereas reserved categories have reduced fees or exemptions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Peon position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Peon post will receive a salary scale of Rs. 27000-46675 along with applicable government allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises application scrutiny, preparation of a merit list based on 10th standard marks in a 1:10 ratio, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official Gadag District Court recruitment portal, filling out the form, uploading documents, and paying the fee.
